method: Exact solid intersections at <=0.5 mm hardware increments; relative-pose cache and bounding-box rejection. Covers angled axle extraction and parking, roller and motor removal, the chassis slide and tray withdrawal, and lower bearing hardware removal. Sampled geometry, not a continuous proof.

parking_path_revalidation.validation: Only cover_screws parking changes. All other geometry, tracks, travel and checks are unchanged. The revised screw path is covered by the attached continuous swept-envelope and global motion-envelope proof, replacing sampled results involving that group.

continuous_proof.method: Continuous solid swept envelopes prove extraction and parking until 5%. Thereafter every parked lid screw lies wholly below the global Y envelope of every other part across all piecewise-linear tracks. Rotating parts use full-circle bounding radii; flexure deformation changes only Z. Cover screws have equal translations and unchanged mutual spacing.

output_centering_validation.method: Source comparison proves the pad-center expression is the sole geometry change. Exact symmetric difference confines changed rack material to the output pad. Whole-pad X envelopes, including its four inserts, are continuously separated from every other part throughout travel and all piecewise-linear explosion stages; rotating parts use full-circle bounds. Insert seating, screw access and blind-pocket backing are rechecked exactly. Unchanged mechanism checks are retained from the source-bound revision 21 reports.
